# Security

English | [简体中文](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-wechat-assistant/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.zh.md)

Please use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-wechat-assistant/security/advisories/new) for security issues. Do not post credentials, private messages or exploit details in public issues.

See the [security policy](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-wechat-assistant/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md) for scope and reporting guidance.
